title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Triage Agent user risk and activity pattern summaries
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents a Triage Agent exception to username anonymisation that the briefing leaves as an open question. The briefing also treats included Security Copilot capacity as unconfirmed for this agent and omits the published monthly allocation ceiling, which could mislead privacy reviews and budgeting. The roadmap facts and the three portal routes are supported.
